info.title: Nudgen Developer API
info.description: REST API for contacts, campaigns, Lifetime triggers, sending domains, brand settings, AI drafts, and local Map Leads search/import. Most endpoints use a Personal Access Token; Lifetime triggers require a scoped team API key.

post.description: PAT uses the active workspace. Defaults to a strict 5 km circle; integer radiusKm 1–100 is explicit. Preserve location, keywords, center, place ID and radius on pagination. Empty filtered pages can still have nextPageToken. Only new searches consume daily quota; pagination does not. Increasing radius starts a new search. Provider failures refund reservations; cancelling an accepted search does not. For NDJSON, parse each line as progress/complete with data, or error with error text. The complete event is authoritative and includes quota and any retry token. Progress snapshots may omit those fields.

403.description: Daily search quota or contact plan limit reached

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Set application/x-ndjson for streamed progress; otherwise application/json.

post.description: Use enrichmentRetryToken from search. Workspace-bound, single-use, expires after 15 minutes; up to 20 server-discovered pending businesses. Does not consume search quota. Merge leads by placeId. A retry may finish without finding an email. Streaming emits progress/complete with data or error with error text. Token is consumed when the retry begins.

404.description: Retry token expired, consumed, or unavailable for this workspace

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Set application/x-ndjson for streamed progress; otherwise application/json.

post.description: Import 1–200 businesses into the active workspace. Invalid/missing emails are skipped; existing emails are updated. Stores available business summary/sources and source details. Adds map-lead, location and keyword tags. Contact plan limits apply.

403.description: Daily search quota or contact plan limit reached

tags.description: Optional manual tags, normalized to lowercase. sync: and crm:hubspot: prefixes are reserved.

get.description: Quota belongs to the active workspace and resets at midnight UTC. Null limit and remaining mean unlimited.

post.description: Autocomplete locations. Reuse the sessionToken when resolving the selected place.

403.description: Daily search quota or contact plan limit reached

input.description: Fewer than two trimmed characters returns an empty list.

post.description: Resolve an autocomplete place ID to search coordinates. This is location resolution, not business contact enrichment.

get.description: Returns the fixed fallback center Ho Chi Minh City (10.82, 106.63), VN. Does not locate the caller or use browser GPS.
Returns the authenticated user for the provided Personal Access Token.
Lists workspaces available to the token owner and identifies the active workspace.
Lists contacts in the active workspace. Contact PII is decrypted in the authorized response.

post.description: Creates one contact in the active workspace.

get.description: Lists campaigns in the active workspace.

post.description: Creates a campaign draft, scheduled campaign, or immediate send when `sendNow` is true.
Launches a campaign now or schedules it for a future time.

patch.description: Allowed transitions: draft to active, active to paused or archived, paused to active or archived. Archived campaigns cannot resume. Pausing or archiving cancels pending and queued executions. A lifetime campaign must be created as a draft; the launch endpoint does not accept it.

409.description: Invalid transition or campaign not ready to activate

get.description: Lists execution history for a lifetime campaign in the active workspace. Search treats values containing @ as an exact email lookup; other values search external contact IDs. Invalid status filters are ignored.

post.description: Requires a team API key with campaigns:trigger scope. The key must belong to the campaign workspace. eventId is an idempotency key within this campaign: a duplicate returns the existing execution with HTTP 200. New executions return HTTP 201; suppressed contacts can produce a skipped execution. Limit: 600 requests per window per key, 64 KiB request body, 32 KiB data object, and JSON nesting depth 8.

409.description: Campaign inactive or sender configuration unavailable

422.description: Trigger data does not match the campaign variable manifest

get.description: Owner or admin only. Raw key secrets are never returned by this endpoint.

post.description: Owner or admin only. The new key has only the campaigns:trigger scope. Save the raw key from this response because it is shown once.

expiresInDays.description: Null creates a key without an expiry.

post.description: Owner or admin only. Rotating invalidates the previous key immediately and returns the new raw key once. Revoked or expired keys cannot be rotated.

delete.description: Owner or admin only. Repeating the request for an already revoked key succeeds.

post.description: Owner or admin only. Custom sender use requires an eligible paid plan.

patch.description: Owner or admin only. Updates sender email and sender name for an existing domain.

post.description: Owner or admin only. Performs verification after the required DNS records have been published. Requires an eligible paid plan.

put.description: Owner or admin only. Pass null to clear the custom default.

post.description: Owner or admin only. Clears an eligible sender hold after its cause has been resolved.
Generates an email subject and HTML draft from campaign context and the active workspace brand settings.

example.campaignGoal: Write a short retention email inviting users to try Nudgen.

teamApiKey.description: Scoped team API key created by an owner or admin. Required scope: campaigns:trigger. Personal Access Tokens do not authorize this endpoint.

bearerAuth.description: Personal Access Token created from Settings -> API Keys.

TeamId.name: teamId
TeamId.description: ID of the currently active workspace. Must match the authenticated team.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired token

Forbidden.description: The workspace cannot perform this write action

enrichmentPending.description: Website enrichment did not finish during the initial search; false after retry does not guarantee an email was found.

data.description: Must satisfy the campaign variable manifest; 32 KiB maximum.

dnsRecords.description: DNS records to publish or check for this domain. Shape may vary by provider.

CreateCampaignRequest.description: A CTA link is required. One-time campaigns also require a goal; lifetime campaigns must be created as drafts and activated with the lifecycle endpoint.

variableManifest.description: Lifetime campaigns only. Declares data.* template variables.

generatedVariableManifest.description: Lifetime campaigns only. Manifest associated with generated content.
